build_byte_bpe_encoder: build a ByteBPE encoder that loads a sentencepiece model and encodes text into byte-level subword pieces
encode_text_with_byte_bpe: encode a string using ByteBPE by byte-encoding it and splitting into sentencepiece subword tokens
decode_byte_bpe_tokens: decode ByteBPE tokenized text back to the original string by removing separators and byte-decoding
add_byte_bpe_args: add the sentencepiece model path argument to an argparse parser for ByteBPE configuration
review_byte_bpe_class: review the ByteBPE class that combines byte encoding with sentencepiece subword tokenization for fairseq
